_comment: Each question lists the courses and chunk types that must be retrieved. Rules may be tuned against 'dev' only. 'held_out' measures the result and must not be used for tuning: if it is, it stops being a fair test.
_first_held_out_score: Before these questions joined dev: routed 24/30 and 4/5 off-topic rejected; plain search 16/30.
_second_held_out_score: Before these questions joined dev: routed 24/30 and 7/7 off-topic rejected; plain search 16/30.
_third_held_out_score: Blind set, run once after the code was fixed: 58/70 and 11/14 off-topic rejected; patterns only 46/70; plain search 36/70. The results have been seen, so write a new blind set before measuring another change.
